lines.en: You've received a new message from Ami Arakawa!
The dawning of a new day dies, but an ending has begun.
And with the blue sky gone we’ll see another setting sun.
It’s orange and...all red or something. It’s glowing and it’s...fun?
Words go here, then more words here. My stupid poem is done.
You know, I’ve got no idea how you do it. It’s easy enough to string together rhymes and whatnot, but putting them together in a way that actually makes sense is just way too difficult for me.
I’m sorry for not following in your footsteps but, in my defense, I can’t imagine you’d have much success when it comes to following mine either.
Oh, right. I’m supposed to slant myself here.
Hello! It’s me again. The one who isn’t the other one or the other one, but is still A one. Or THE one depending on how you want to prioritize stuff.
Are you enjoying another trip to the beach? Because I know I am!
Though, I wouldn’t mind a break from the heat. Things have gotten out of hand lately but, despite how much I WANT to do something about it, I’m not sure if I CAN.
Anyway, let’s see here...Oh, right!
Things have been kind of tough for you lately, huh?
What with not really understanding why you’re suddenly so much more...well, let’s just say “aware” for lack of a better word.
The things you once found interesting are starting to get a little dull, and so you’re now in search of something else to make you feel alive instead.
This is totally normal! It happens to everyone.
And while we all have our own unique ways of dealing with it, your situation is a little complicated since your life is kind of moving at hyper-speed right now to make up for lost time.
So do what you always do and fasten your seatbelt as your bus could very quickly veer off a cliff if you’re not careful when steering it.
Actually, in hindsight, I’m not sure how much help a seatbelt would be if you were to drive off a cliff...but still! Fasten it either way.
Because what I’m trying to tell you right now is that luring yourself into a false sense of security is the WORST thing you can do.
When your days feel like they’re droning on and every morning is the same as always, it’s easy to sit back and think to yourself, “You know what? This isn’t so bad!”
But it’s that exact line of thinking that makes you the most vulnerable.
Do you know who taught me that?
It’s someone close to you.
Someone who did that same exact thing and wound up paying the price for it.
Anyway, I just want you to know that you have to be careful.
And even though you very likely can’t hear me right now and that things might not even change if you COULD, I wouldn’t be able to forgive myself if I didn’t tell you.
This could be your last summer.
But wouldn’t it be sad if it was someone else’s too?
You know what? I’m gonna try my hand at another poem.
It can be our little way of communicating with one another since every other method is a little...difficult right now.
Oh, and forgive me for using a cliche template to write it, but I’m still a novice when it comes to stuff like this.
Anyway, here goes nothing.
Roses are red, my eyes are blue.
The grass is all greenish, and you’re the real you!
The real you is awesome! Just a little confused.
But how could you not be when I’m confused too?
Done!
Kinda mid, huh?
I’ll get better. I promise.
But until then, stay strong!
Like, really.
I’ve got a bad feeling about the end of this chapter.
: How’s that, my sweet? Is there any other...area you’d like me to focus on?
: Perhaps one we may need to relocate somewhere private for?
: No thank you, Nodoka. For the millionth time, this is plenty.
: If you keep your eyes closed, you can pretend I’m anyone you want. Maybe even one of those handsome, rugged men from all those naughty books you read?
: Nodoka, I’m reading Watership Down right now. Which you should know because you’re the one who lent it to me.
: And which of the characters do you most see yourself mating with? I’ve always been rather partial to Hyzenthlay myself.
: They’re rabbits...
: Sorry, is that supposed to make some sort of difference?
: Hah...forget it. I’m not attracted to animals and I am not attracted to you. And if that is going to be a problem, you can stop rubbing my shoulders.
: Alas...the gap between our teacher and me grows stronger by the day. I’m getting rather jealous that he gets to have all the fun that I’ve been forced to simply dream of.
: If he would even call it fun. I can’t help but feel like I’ve been nothing but a disappointment in that department as well.
: You know that’s not true.
: You’re not a disappointment in any area, Futaba. Anyone who thinks otherwise can not see the things I see.
: Then I guess I just can’t “see the things you see.” Whatever that means.
: What that means is, despite what you may think, the world is lucky to have such a pure, unblemished creature spending time on it.
: You wouldn’t be able to call me pure anymore if you’d seen the things I’ve done with him.
: Need I remind you that I have seen the things you’ve done with him?
: You’ve seen one thing and it wasn’t even that big of a deal.
: I’d be happy to see more, you know.
: Not right now, Nodoka.
: Can I take that as an invitation?
: Not right now, Nodoka.
: Hah...Futaba, spending this much time sulking is going to impact your chances in beating me tomorrow. Should you not be focusing on that instead?
: The fact that you’re spending your free time massaging me shows that you’re not that interested in giving it your all either.
: The difference there is that I am simply unmotivated. You know better than most that I would be writing right now if my heart was truly in it.
: Well, maybe...mine’s not in it either.
: And to think I believed your dive into the world of true sexual activity would serve as inspiration for your stories. Yet here you are, the same as always.
: Things...don’t really feel any different, to be honest.
: I’m glad I was able to move forward with Sensei, don’t get me wrong...but I still feel exactly the same as I always have and...
: And I know I’m not the only one, so...
: You think he’s sleeping with someone else?
: I know he is.
: Any guesses as to who that may be? Anyone you’d like me to tear to shreds?
: No thank you, Nodoka. I’ll...handle that in my own way.
: Futaba, I love you. But right now, it seems like you’re incapable of handling pretty much anything.
: Perhaps you should try being more like our other sexually active friends? Just look at how well they get along when they’re not licking each other.
: Mnh...this is way harder than I thought it was going to be.
: I think what you have now is great. It doesn’t have to be, like...a million paragraphs long. Just speak from the heart and stuff.
: If I speak from the heart, I’ll just wind up complaining about all the stupid shit he does and how he got to see your boobs before I did. And I doubt that will win me the competition.
: Hey, who knows? Sensei likes when people are straight with him and he might actually be into you, like...spilling out that kind of stuff.
: Mm...no. Some other time, sure. But I’m trying to approach this from a different angle this time.
: Then...maybe try playing up the friendship angle?
: Friendship angle?
: Yeah. You don’t really worship him the same way everybody else seems to, and that makes it look like you guys are pretty close sometimes.
: I don’t think we’re particularly close.
: Though, there was that one time I tackled him in the sketchy basement.
: Write about that then.
: No reaction at all to hearing that? Wack.
: I’ve watched enough anime to know that you probably just got scared of the dark and landed on top of him or something.
: You’re good.
: I’ve had my share of cliche anime moments too. I’m pretty sure we’re all obligated to as Japanese school girls.
: Maybe that’s the problem. I can’t approach this as a typical anime-style school girl because I’m always on the opposite end of things. People confess to me. I am not people.
: I am people. And I confessed to you. Maybe just let me write it?
: Well, what would you put in this middle part here? I feel like this is where I should open up about why I allegedly like him, but I don’t think I know enough about him yet.
: I have some ideas, but the last time I attempted to display my Sensei-based knowledge, we both got really mad and then I yelled out a bunch of stuff about you taking too long to finger me.
: Yeah, but I do finger you now. So that probably won’t happen again.
: Then maybe something like...
: At first, I thought I was okay with just being friends.
: I haven’t spent much time around guys before, and I was always kind of worried I wouldn’t really fit in with them.
: But you always make me feel like I’m a little less of a fuck-up than I actually am. And being around you makes me comfortable in a way no one else ever has before.
: You’re cool and mysterious...And you pay attention to me when I’m talking, even if what I’m talking about doesn’t make any sense at all.
: You’re there for me when things get bad, and you’re happy for me whenever they get good again. And sharing both of those moments is what makes what we have so special.
: Then, you could end with something like...I respect you a lot. And I’ve always admired you. But maybe that admiration is...a little more than just that.
: I want to know you better...in a million different ways.
: And I want you to know me too.
: That was suspiciously good.
: Was it?
: Very suspicious. Especially considering how nervous you were when you confessed to me.
: Maybe it’s...because I’m not actually confessing right now?
: Maybe. But it sounds more like this is something you’ve actually, like...put thought into.
: Like it’s...something you were going to say to him at some point.
: Hahah...
: No.
: No, that never even crossed my mind.
: Rin, you can be honest with me. I know I’ve gotten all jealous and shit in the past, but I’m trying to, like...not be that way anymore.

: If you used to like Sensei, just be honest about it. It’s not like finding out somebody has the hots for him is going to surprise me at this point when I already know he’s boning some of our friends.
: Are you just going to stay silent?
: It’s embarrassing...
: Why didn’t you ever tell him? Because of Chika?
: It was...no. Maybe. I don’t know.
: She might have had something to do with it. But it wasn’t until after all that happened that...I kind of...
: You kind of?
: Kind of...brain.
: He’s just...so much older than me. It felt wrong. Or, like...I was just being stupid or something.
: You do have a history of doing that.
: I’m well aware, Otoha. Thank you for reminding me.
: I don’t think the age thing is that big of a deal, though.
: What? Weren’t you, like...
: Didn’t you have the exact opposite opinion of that before?
: I could have sworn you thought it was super creepy that Sensei’s into, like...you know. Us.
: It is. What I meant is, more specifically, I don’t think it’s weird for girls our age to have crushes on older people.
: We can’t help but look up to and admire the adults we’re around all the time. So if one of us starts developing feelings for one of those adults, it’s not like...weird, right? It’s normal.
: I mean...I’m obviously not one to talk. And I see where you’re coming from. It just feels like this isn’t how you used to-
: Yeah, yeah. Whatever. Could you give me that speech again?
: I think I’m gonna steal some of it after all.
: Nee-chan, what are you doing? Why are you here and why did I have to leave all of my friends just to come welcome you?
: Do you not care about your big sister anymore? Shouldn’t you want to welcome me?
: Shouldn’t you be working? And not hanging out on a beach with a bunch of girls who worship you?
: Do you have any idea what sort of chaos would break out if your presence here was known by literally anyone other than me?
: Of course. Why else do you think I made you come get me? I need your help getting to the inn without being detected.
: Oh, which one of us doesn’t care about the other now?
: I’m allowed to use you for my own personal gain. I was born first.
: Yeah. Way first. Go be a dinosaur somewhere else and stop chasing after your youth. It is gone and never coming back no matter how many miles you run each day.
: Speaking of my exercise regimen, where’s Akira? He and I have business.
: Business?...
: That’s right, baby sister. I’m here on an important business trip. To conduct business.
: Nothing more. Nothing less.
: I really hope I don’t become this pompous when I lose my virginity.
: Boop.
: This is hardly the time for booping! Go home!
: Sure. Right after I finish my business transaction.
: Stop calling it that! It’s weird!
: I can’t. You might be recording me.
: You’re my sister!
: Exactly. Which means you might be trying to steal my time in the spotlight. Royal families used to kill each other all the time for the crown, you know.
: Nee-chan! Akira is busy this weekend! He doesn’t have time for business!
: Oh, he’ll make time for me. It’s a very important transaction.
: Brag some more, why don’t you?...
: Tsk tsk, baby sister. If only you were older and more attractive. Maybe then you’d have a chance at stealing my boyfriend.
: Careful, Nee-chan. I could be recording.
: And by “boyfriend,” I meant “business partner.” Thank you, Noriko.
: Uh-huh. Could you take your finger off of my nose now? I can’t breathe.
: As soon as you take me to Akira. I’m sure he’s eagerly awaiting my arrival as we speak.
: Any last words, Arakawa?
: Yes — thank you.
: For what?
: This.
: You’re pathetic.
: Can you shift your right leg a bit? I can only kind of peek up your skirt and I’d like the last thing I ever see to be a tiny bit closer to actual nudity.
: Okay, you guys. That’s enough pretend-homicide for the day. Wakana, why not come on down from the bed and-
: And completely disregard the sanctity of truth or dare? What kind of a fool do you take me for?
: I am here to kill a pervert and I will not leave this inn until Arakawa is six feet beneath the soil.
: Is this really that big of a deal? It’s just a poem, Wakana.
: No. “The Road Not Taken” is just a poem. This is a betrayal.
: I was nice to you for almost three hours under the pretense that you would participate in this competition. Do you have any idea how mentally taxing being nice to you is?
: Did I give you permission to speak?
: You asked me a question.
: It was rhetorical, Arakawa!
: Senseeeeei, are you in here? I need help with-
: Woah! Forget whatever I came in here for! I want to sleep in this room now!
: This isn’t really the best time, Kirin. Could you go be horny somewhere else? I’m trying to prevent a murder.
: And walk away from this?! No way!
: Also, you’re just standing there! If anything, you're an accessory to murder!
: I am a lover, not a fighter.
: I am a fighter. And I will now kill this man for slighting me — as well as anyone else who bears witness to my crime.
: But if you kill him who else will teach me how to fish?!
: Is that why you’re here? Why would you just assume that I know how to fish?
: Should I have assumed you’d be getting a footjob from Miss Watabe instead?! Because while that does seem slightly more probable, it’s still out of left field!
: Man, I tried to warn you things would get out of control once Wakana showed up, Senpai. But nooooo. Screw apologies and screw poetry. Let’s just get stepped on instead.
: I regret nothing.
: Me next!
: Everyone, shut up! You’re giving me a headache!
Meanwhile...
